steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each service's status is placed in the order it changed during the day.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 service is down with no ticket

findings.title: Down for more than 15 minutes with no ticket
findings.fix: Open a ticket and start the incident

findings.title: Host with alerts and no owner
Status with no timestamp
findings.fix: Record when the status was read

outcome.notChecked: Problems the monitoring does not measure.
